scripts.lint:emoji: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const files = ['manifest.json', 'popup.html', 'popup.js', 'popup.css', 'content.js', 'content.css']; const emojiRegex = /[\u{1F300}-\u{1F9FF}\u{2600}-\u{26FF}\u{2700}-\u{27BF}\u{1F1E0}-\u{1F1FF}\u{1F200}-\u{1F2FF}\u{1F600}-\u{1F64F}\u{1F680}-\u{1F6FF}]/u; let failed = false; files.forEach(f => { if (fs.existsSync(f)) { const lines = fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8').split('\n'); lines.forEach((line, i) => { if (emojiRegex.test(line)) { console.error('Emoji found in ' + f + ':' + (i+1)); failed = true; } }); } }); if (failed) process.exit(1); console.log('Lint passed: No emojis in source files.');"
